disposition: The 6.08246-day trial is an approximately 28-fold alias of rapid 5.213-hour variability; it also fails the later timing-refined holdout.
limitations: The source of the variable light has not been localized. SAP and PDC share pixels; the short-variation subtraction uses already-inspected observations and is a diagnostic, not independent validation. This rejection applies to this trial and does not rule out other planets.
